_comment: Hand-authored source for the group and Agent descriptors.
tools/gen_agents.py expands `groups` into the flat `members` list that
template.lua composes at install time, and tests/test_descriptors.py
re-runs the expansion to prove the committed descriptors still match.
Members are named here; everything else about them -- version, tarball,
sha256, licence -- stays in the member's own descriptor.

description.en: Five web-surface quality-of-life plugins that compose cleanly: @file mentions, inline annotation, turn rewind, desktop notifications and a background task bar.
description.zh: 五个可干净共存的 Web 界面增强插件：@文件引用、选中批注、对话回退、桌面通知、后台任务状态条。

description.en: A ready-to-run coding Agent on the web surface: the harness plus five composed plugins, booted with `dsh --profile coding`.
description.zh: 开箱即用的 Web 界面编码 Agent：harness + 五个已组合插件，`dsh --profile coding` 直接启动。

description.en: A terminal coding Agent: the Claude Code style full-screen TUI surface with desktop notifications, booted with `dsh --profile tui-coding`.
description.zh: 终端编码 Agent：Claude Code 风格全屏 TUI 界面 + 桌面通知，`dsh --profile tui-coding` 启动。
